WITH qualifying_fee_records AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(net_fee_rate) AS record_count
  FROM qualifying_fee_records
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
),
with_side_averages AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    avg_net_fee_rate,
    record_count,
    AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  side,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  record_count,
  avg_net_fee_rate - side_avg_net_fee_rate AS difference
FROM with_side_averages
WHERE avg_net_fee_rate > side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A record is counted only when both fee rates are present, because net fee rate is undefined when either feerate or rebrate is NULL; SQLite AVG ignores those missing net rates.
